messages.author: 4876fb50eee0a61a
messages.subject: Trouble running WinBUGS rats example
parts:
Hi!

Trying to run the simple WinBUGS rats example.  I'm using R Studio on a Mac, running OS X 10.11.6.

I'm running the file rats.R. The data seems to load fine, and the rstan package loads up ok, but then when it hits the following command

rats = stan(file = "rats.stan", data = data, chains = chains,
            init = init, iter = iter)

I get the following error message:

Error in if (nchar(CXX) == 0) { : argument is of length zero
In addition: Warning message:
running command ''/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' CMD config CXX 2>/dev/null' had status 69  

Any idea what I'm doing wrong?

Thanks, Ed Green

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Trouble running WinBUGS rats example
parts:
On Thursday, September 29, 2016 at 3:50:26 PM UTC-4, Ed Green wrote:
I get the following error message:

Error in if (nchar(CXX) == 0) { : argument is of length zero
In addition: Warning message:
running command ''/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' CMD config CXX 2>/dev/null' had status 69  

Any idea what I'm doing wrong?

In the toolchain configuration step of

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Mac-OS-X-Prerequisite-Installation-Instructions#step-23--install-xcode

you forgot the third bullet point
  • Open Xcode once to accept the license agreement (don't forget this step!!)

Ben
